findings.location: content.body.steps[3].blocks[0].text: "Від 31 до 99, крім круглих десятків (40, 50…), — три слова з y"; content.body.steps[13].blocks[0].items[0]: "31–99, крім круглих десятків, — з y".
findings.description: These statements present the usual spelling as obligatory. Standard Spanish also permits fused spellings with i, such as treintaicinco and cuarentaicinco.
findings.suggestion: Describe the separate spelling with y as the usual form taught in this course, without claiming that it is the only correct spelling.

items.reviewerAnswer: No learner response is requested. The examples use the usual multiword spellings of compound numbers; permitted fused spellings also exist.
items.notes: The seven numbered teaching stages are interspersed with practice and summary steps; the larger number of step objects is not itself an inconsistency.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Ortografía de la lengua española (2010), chapter VIII, discussion of compound cardinal numerals and permissible fused spellings from thirty onward (from memory).

findings.description: For a literal half of a quantity, current Ukrainian orthography writes пів separately from the following genitive singular noun.
findings.suggestion: Replace the phrase with "Пів дюжини (6) яєць".

items.notes: The Spanish answer and the explanation of media agreeing with docena are correct.
sources: Український правопис (2019), rule on separate spelling of the numeral пів with a following noun in the genitive singular when expressing half of something (from memory).

findings.location: task.hints[1].blocks[0].text and task.feedback.incorrectUk: "Відповідати можна цифрами"; task.hints[2].kind: "reveal", containing "Кілограм помідорів і дюжину яєць.".
findings.description: The instructions invite a numerical response although this task only accepts option selection. The reveal hint also supplies the substantive translation of the clip under a kind other than translation, contrary to the listening-task restriction.
findings.suggestion: Replace the numerical-input instruction with an instruction to select an option. Label the translated-content hint as translation.

items.notes: Option a accurately represents the supplied transcript. The recording itself cannot be assessed in this text-only review.
sources: Packet: task.mode is "choice", task.input is "options", and the available responses are options a–c.
Review duties: identify misleading instructions and conflicting feedback.
Course contract, rule 7: a listening transcript or translation may appear only in hints of kind transcript or translation.

findings.location: task.errors[0].feedbackUk: "Числа 31–99, крім круглих десятків, пишемо трьома словами"; task.hints[0].blocks[0].text and task.feedback.incorrectUk: "ставимо y і пишемо окремо".
findings.description: The explanation makes separate spelling obligatory, although fused forms such as cuarentaicinco are also permitted. The reviewed error cuarentaycinco is indeed incorrect: the permissible fused form uses i.
findings.suggestion: Present the three-word form as the usual spelling, and retain the rejection of cuarentaycinco without implying that cuarentaicinco is incorrect.

items.reviewerAnswer: cuarenta y cinco; the permitted fused variant cuarentaicinco also fits.
items.notes: No closed key is specified, so omission of cuarentaicinco from accepted does not by itself establish that the system rejects it.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Ortografía de la lengua española (2010), chapter VIII, discussion of compound cardinal numerals and permissible fused spellings with i (from memory).

findings.location: task.slots[1].errors[0].feedbackUk: "Числа 31–99, крім круглих десятків, пишемо трьома словами"; task.hints[0].blocks[0].text and task.feedback.incorrectUk: "ставимо y і пишемо окремо".
findings.description: The explanation incorrectly treats multiword spelling as mandatory. Treintaicinco is permitted, although the explicitly reviewed spelling treintaycinco is incorrect.
findings.suggestion: Describe treinta y cinco as the usual spelling. Explain that treintaycinco is malformed without excluding the permitted fused form treintaicinco.

items.reviewerAnswer: En el museo hay doscientas fotos y treinta y cinco mapas. The variant with treintaicinco also fits.
items.notes: Both slots are open, so the absent fused variant is not demonstrably graded incorrect. Doscientas correctly agrees with fotos.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Ortografía de la lengua española (2010), chapter VIII, discussion of compound cardinal numerals and permissible fused spellings with i (from memory).
